name: ui-tap
prompt: Short soft plastic button tap, a clean UI click with a gentle snap and no reverb tail

name: ui-back
prompt: Soft low wooden toggle click, a quieter descending tap for going back in a menu

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Short dull electric error buzzer, a low flat buzz rejecting a wrong move

name: puck-strike
prompt: Hard plastic mallet smacking a puck across an air hockey table, sharp impact crack with a brief sliding rattle

name: wall-bank
prompt: Plastic puck bouncing off a padded rink wall, quick hollow thud with a soft rebound

name: obstacle-clack
prompt: Puck clacking against a small wooden peg obstacle on a game board, bright short knock

name: countdown-tick
prompt: Single crisp metronome-like countdown tick, a clean high wooden block strike

name: go-whistle
prompt: Short bright referee whistle blast signaling the start of play

name: goal-horn
prompt: Arena goal horn blast with a swelling crowd cheer, triumphant scoring moment

name: win-fanfare
prompt: Triumphant short brass fanfare flourish, rising major-key stadium victory stinger

name: lose-sting
prompt: Descending muted trombone wah-wah defeat sting, comical sad ending

name: achievement-chime
prompt: Bright two-note glockenspiel achievement chime with a light magical sparkle

name: overtime-siren
prompt: Rising arena siren wail, a tense hockey overtime alarm building urgency

name: budget-empty
prompt: Hollow coin-empty clunk, a dull mechanical thunk for running out of moves

name: clock-warning
prompt: Urgent electronic double beep alarm, two quick high pips from a digital sports scoreboard timer warning that time is nearly up

name: save-block
prompt: Solid rubbery thump of a plastic paddle blocking a fast sliding puck, a firm padded stop with a short low resonance

name: draw-sting
prompt: Neutral two-note synthesizer chime that ends unresolved, an even electronic tone for a tied result with a soft fade

name: undo-rewind
prompt: Quick reverse tape rewind zip, a short rising electronic swoosh played backwards

name: chat-ping
prompt: Soft glassy notification ping, a single gentle bell tone for an incoming message
